text:
The classic Hakone mistake?
Doing the whole ropeway loop, then all of it again.
From Moto-Hakone, a bus does it in about 30 minutes 👇

👉 One small change, and you get an extra hour:
https://japanbystation.com/gora-to-lake-ashi-bus-or-ropeway

❌ The mistake
Most first-timers think the loop is the only way.
It's beautiful one way.
The second time, it's mostly queues and changes.

✅ The fix
Ride the ropeway out while you're fresh.
About 30 minutes over Owakudani's steam vents.
Cross the lake by boat to Moto-Hakone.
🚌 Then take the bus home:
about 30 minutes to Hakone-Yumoto for ¥1,210.

⏰ Watch the clock
The ropeway runs until 16:45
(until 16:15 in December and January).
Go out in the morning, not after lunch.

🌬️ On a windy day
The ropeway and boats can stop in strong wind.
If they're down, the bus does the whole trip.

👉 Where to eat at each end:
https://japanbystation.com/gora-to-lake-ashi-bus-or-ropeway

Have you done the loop both ways before?
Save this for next time 📌
